facts.business: Cipla Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products across various geographies.
key_risks: DPCO matters and litigation with NPPA regarding alleged overcharging of scheduled drugs
Impairment of investments in subsidiaries due to uncertainty in future cash flow projections
Revenue recognition complexity due to discounts, returns, rebates and price adjustments across geographies
Risk of revenue overstatement due to performance pressure and incentive schemes
